reader_summary.headline: Howard Marks shares advice on investing during fear, uncertainty, and market crashes.
reader_summary.overview: Legendary investor Howard Marks discusses how to make money while others worry about a market crash. He explains the difference between first and second-level thinking and how to invest when fear is high. The conversation also covers his partnership with Sam Parr and Shaan Puri.

key_points.text: Marks explains that second-level thinking means thinking deeper than the obvious market reaction to find value.
He notes that raising $11 billion was possible even during a time of crisis.
Marks states that the only true success in life is living your life your own way.

reader_summary.why_it_matters: Listeners learn practical strategies for making investment decisions when the market is scary.
